_comment: hosted#194 expected-fail (xfail) list — findings the scanner CORRECTLY
detects on the current image that are tracked in open issues. Each lets
the gate stay green while the referenced issue is open, WITHOUT hiding
the finding (it's reported as KNOWN-FAILURE in every run).
Enforcement flip: check-expected-fail-freshness.sh fails the build when
an entry's issue is CLOSED — the fixing PR must delete the entry (paper
trail). If a check unexpectedly PASSES while its entry is still here,
scan.mjs prints an XPASS warning telling you to remove the entry.
Schema: id (stable name), issue (hosted issue number), kind

entries.note: Upstream flame icon renders in the /alerting/list 'Grafana-managed' rules-group header: an inline React icon component (svg[data-testid=icon-grafana], FFF200->F15A29 gradient) — not an overridable asset file. TODO(#187): once the skin replaces/hides it, delete this entry.

The breadcrumb/login logo carries alt="Grafana" on every page. The IMAGE is our overridden asset (renders the Dartastic heart); the alt ATTRIBUTE leaks because dartastic-skin.js only rewrites text nodes. Found by this gate 2026-07-06; needs its own fix (attr rewrite pass or bundle sed).
Grafana 13's auto-opening "What's new" dialog (role=dialog) carries this aria-label on every page. Found by this gate 2026-07-06.

Body copy of the same "What's new" dialog ('Grafana Assistant is now available to OSS users'). Found by this gate 2026-07-06; fix is likely a config/feature-toggle to suppress the drawer plus replacer coverage.

Rule-source filter radio renders 'Grafana managed' (SPACE, not hyphen) — the dartastic-skin.js REPLACEMENTS map only covers 'Grafana-managed'. Found by this gate 2026-07-06; one-line REPLACEMENTS addition.
The built-in Alertmanager card's logo alt text. Same class as brand-logo-alt-text (attributes unreachable by the text-node replacer). Found by this gate 2026-07-06.
Drilldown landing tagline 'Drill down into your data using Grafana's powerful queryless apps'. Found by this gate 2026-07-06; i18n rewrite or REPLACEMENTS candidate.

entries.pattern: (settings across Grafana|your Grafana config|Isolated instances of Grafana|Migrate to Grafana Cloud)
entries.note: Administration > General card copy (default preferences / settings / organizations / Grafana Cloud migration). Found by this gate 2026-07-06; i18n rewrite gap — admin pages are operator-visible on a customer box.

The bundled drilldown APP PLUGINS' display names are upstream's own product names ('Grafana Logs Drilldown' etc. — breadcrumbs, welcome banners). Same owner-decision class as pyroscope-plugin-display-name: nominative product name vs. patch. Found by this gate 2026-07-06.
Breadcrumb title= / welcome-banner aria-label carrying the same upstream drilldown plugin names.

Upstream feedback-survey links (forms.gle / qualtrics) inside the drilldown app plugins name the upstream in their tooltips — customer-visible AND link off-platform. Found by this gate 2026-07-06; candidates for removal via CSS/JS surgery.

The Profiles drilldown app renders an ONBOARDING page while Pyroscope has no data yet (fresh boot — exactly what CI scans): 'Configure Grafana', 'Grafana Cloud Credentials/Profiles' setup copy with grafana.com links. Disappears once profiles flow, but a new customer's first look hits it. Found by this gate 2026-07-06.

The Loki datasource LOGO carries alt="Loki" (loki_icon.*.svg) — a Grafana Labs mark the runtime text-replacer can't reach (attributes only, same class as the #196 attribute pass). Seen on /alerting/list; datasource-logo alts surface on other pages too, so scoped to all routes. The text-node marks (Loki/Tempo/Pyroscope/Set Up Your Pyroscope Server, and the old 'Grafana Pyroscope' plugin name) are already renamed in skin/js/dartastic-skin.js REPLACEMENTS. Tracked in #200 (attribute pass); delete on close. Found by this gate 2026-07-06.
